english.title: Take photograph of a person / thing within the Protected Area of AWE Aldermaston
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) took a photograph of **(..SPECIFY THE SUBJECT OF THE PHOTOGRAPH..) within the Protected Area of the Atomic Weapons Establishment Aldermaston
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(e) and 9 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Aldermaston Byelaws 2007 and section 17(2) of the Military Lands Act 1892.

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 10 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Aldermaston Byelaws 2007 provides that these byelaws shall not apply to anything done (a) by a lawful user in connection with the discharge of his functions; or (b) by a person acting under and in accordance with any permission given in writing by the Appointed Person.
(ii) Byelaw 11 of the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE) Aldermaston Byelaws 2007 provides that (a) the Appointed Person; (b) any officer, warrant officer, or non-commissioned officer in uniform and acting under the instructions of the Appointed Person; and (c) any other Crown servant authorised in writing by the Appointed Person are authorised to remove from the Protected Areas and Controlled Areas and to take into custody without warrant any person committing an offence against these byelaws and to remove any vehicle, aircraft, animal or thing in contravention of these byelaws from the Protected Area.
